sources.title: Introducing K2 Horizon: Frontier Performance, Radically Open - ifm.ai
sources.snippet: The result is K2 Horizon MoVA 36B-A4B: a model with 36 billion total parameters but approximately 4 billion active parameters per token. Under the same training conditions, it performs only slightly below the dense Horizon 32B model while requiring substantially fewer active parameters.
